A Paddle News article (published 2026-09-02) says Brightwater announced a 2027 expedition sponsorship program for travel creators featuring the touring line. The creator's slow-travel and hiking audience would plausibly suit an expedition sponsorship, but this is untested against Brightwater's actual plans. Strongest counterargument: the brand may be ending the very program this sponsorship would use. Contact readiness: not assessed in this run because of the evidence stop.
